data.value: 1. Connection Architecture • OleDbConnection: Links to the database via a Connection String. • Provider: The database driver (e.g., Jet.OLEDB.4.0). • Data Source: The file path. 2. Populating DataSets (Fill) The OleDbDataAdapter bridges the database and memory. Calling da.Fill() automatically opens the connection, executes the query. 3. Iterating the Hierarchy DataSets store disconnected data. Extract records by looping sequentially through the structure: DataSet.Tables $\rightarrow$ Table.Rows $\rightarrow$ Table.Columns.
